lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Behold Me standing at the door And hear Me pleading evermore, With gentle voice, O, heart of sin, May I come in? May I come in?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Behold Me standing at the door And hear Me pleading evermore: Say, weary heart, opprest with sin, May I come in? May I come in?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I bore the cruel thorns for thee, I waited long and patiently; Say, weary heart, opprest with sin, May I come in? May I come in?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I would not plead with thee in vain: Remember all My grief and pain! I died to ransom thee from sin, May I come in? May I come in?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: I bring thee joy from Heaven above, I bring thee pardon, peace, and love: Say weary heart, opprest with sin, May I come in? May I come in?

title: WHO IS ON THE LORD'S SIDE?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Who is on the Lord's side? Who will serve the King? Who will be His helpers, Other lives to bring? Who will leave the world's side? Who will face the foe? Who is on the Lord's side? Who for Him will go? By Thy call of mercy, By Thy grace divine, We are on the Lord's side, Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Not for weight of glory, Nor for crown and palm, Enter we the army, Raise the warrior psalm: But for love that claimeth Lives for whom He died: He whom Jesus nameth Must be on His side! By Thy love constraining By Thy grace divine, We are on the Lord's side, Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Jesus, Thou hast bought us, Not with gold or gem, But with Thine own life-blood For Thy diadem; With Thy blessing filling All who come to Thee, Thou hast made us willing, Thou hast made us free. By Thy grand redemption, By Thy grace divine, We are on the Lord's side, Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Fierce may be the conflict, Strong may be the foe; But the King's own army None can overthrow: Round His standard ranging, Victory is secure, For His truth unchanging Makes the triumph sure, Joyfully enlisting, By Thy grace divine, We are on the Lord's side Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I shall wear a golden crown when I get home, I shall lay my burdens down when I get home; Clad in robes of glory, I shall sing the story Of the Lord who brought me when I get home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: When I get home, when I get home, All sorrow will be over when I get home; When I get home, when I get home, All sorrow will be over when I get home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: All the darkness will be past when I get home, I shall see the light at last when I get home; Light from Heaven streaming, o'er my pathway beaming, Ever guides me onward till I get home.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I shall see my Saviour's face when I get home, Sing again of saving grace when I get home; I shall stand before Him, gladly I'll adore Him, Ever to be with Him when I get home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Come to the Saviour, make no delay; Here in His word He has shown us the way; Here in our midst He's standing to-day, Tenderly saying, "Come!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Joyful, joyful will the meeting be, When from sin our hearts are pure and free, And we shall gather, Saviour, with Thee, In our eternal home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: "Suffer the children!" O, hear His voice! Let every heart leap forth and rejoice; And let us freely make Him our choice, Do not delay, but come.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Think once again, He's with us to-day; Heed now His blest command and obey; Hear now His accents tenderly say, "Will you, My children, come?"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Where will you spend eternity? This question comes to you and me! Tell me, what shall your answer be? Where will you spend eternity?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Eternity! Eternity! Where will you spend eternity?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Many are choosing Christ to-day, Turning from all their sins away; Heaven shall their happy portion be, Where will you spend eternity?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Leaving the strait and narrow way, Going the downward road to-day, Sad will their final ending be - Lost through a long eternity!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Repent; believe this very hour, Trust in the Saviour's grace and power, Then will your joyous answer be: "Saved through a long eternity!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Years I spent in vanity and pride, Caring not my Lord was crucified, Knowing not it was for me He died On Calvary.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Mercy there was great, and grace was free, Pardon there was multiplied to me, There my burdened soul found liberty, At Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: By God's word at last my sin I learned, Then I trembled at the law I'd spurned Till my guilty soul, imploring, turned To Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Now I've given Jesus everything, Now I gladly own Him as my King, Now my raptured soul can only sing Of Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: O! The love that drew salvation's plan, O! The grace that brought it down to man, O! The mighty gulf that God did span At Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Wither pilgrims are you going, Going each with staff in hand? We are going on a journey, Going at our King's command. Over hills, and plains, and valleys, We are going to His palace, We are going to His palace, Going to the better land.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Tell us, pilgrims, what you hope for In that far-off, better land? Spotless robes and crowns of glory From a Saviour's loving hand. We shall drink of life's clear river, We shall dwell with God forever, We shall dwell with God forever, In the bright, that better land.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Pilgrims, may we travel with you To that bright, and better land? Come and welcome, come and welcome, Welcome to our pilgrim band. Come, O, Come, and do not leave us; Christ is waiting to receive us, Christ is waiting to receive us, In that bright, that better land.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Peace, like a river, is flooding my soul, Since Christ my Saviour maketh me whole; Sweet peace abiding, my portion shall be, Jesus, my Saviour, is precious to me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Precious to me... precious is He... Jesus shall ever be precious to me; Precious to me... precious is He... Jesus shall ever be precious to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Joy is abounding, -my heart gaily sings, Cleave I the heavens, mount up on wings, Christ hath exalted, my soul He set free, Jesus, my Saviour, is precious to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: O, precious Jesus, how lovely Thou art! Come, and abiding, rule in my heart; Break every fetter, Thy face let me see; Then Thou shalt ever be precious to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I am safe, whatever may betide me; I am safe, whoever may deride me; I am safe, as long as I confide me; In the hallow of God's hand.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: In the hallow of His hand, In the hallow of His hand, I am safe while God Himself doth hold me In the hallow of His hand.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: "What though fierce the stormy blasts roar round me?" "What though sore life's trials oft confound me?" I am safe, for naught of ill can wound me In the hallow of God's hand.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Everlasting arms of love enfold me, Words of peace the voice divine has told me; I am safe, while God Himself doth hold me In the hallow of His hand.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Fade, fade, each earthly joy, Jesus is mine. Break every tender tie, Jesus is mine. Dark is the wilderness, Earth has no resting place, Jesus alone can bless: Jesus is mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Tempt not my soul away, Jesus is mine. Here would I ever stay, Jesus is mine. Perishing things of day, Born but for one brief day, Pass from my heart away: Jesus is mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Farewell mortality, Jesus is mine. Welcome eternity, Jesus is mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Welcome O loved and blest, Welcome sweet scenes of rest, Welcome, my Saviour's breast: Jesus is mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: All over the world the Spirit is moving, All over the world, as the prophets said it would be, All over the world, there's a mighty revelation Of the glory of the Lord As the waters cover the sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: All over the church the Spirit is moving, All over the church, as the prophets said it would be, All over the church, there's a mighty revelation Of the glory of the Lord As the waters cover the sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Right now in our midst the Spirit is moving , Right now in our midst, as the prophets said it would be, Right now in our midst, there's a mighty revelation Of the glory of the Lord As the waters cover the sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Deep down in my heart the Spirit is moving, Deep down in my heart, as the prophets said it would be, Deep down in my heart, there's a mighty revelation Of the glory of the Lord As the waters cover the sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: O, what a wonderful, wonderful day - Day I will never forget; After I wandered in darkness away Jesus my Saviour I met! O, what a tender compassionate Friend, He met the need of my heart, Shadows dispelling with joy I'm telling, He made all the darkness depart.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Heaven came down and glory filled my soul, When at the cross the Saviour made me whole, My sins were washed away and my night was turned to day, Heaven came down and glory filled my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Born of the Spirit with life from above Into God's family divine, Justified fully through Calvary's love, O, what a standing is mine! And the transaction so quickly was made, When as a sinner I came, Took of the offer of grace He did proffer, He saved me, O, praise His dear name.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Now I've a hope that will surely endure After the passing of time; I have a future in Heaven for sure, There are those mansions sublime; And it's because of that wonderful day, When at the cross I believed, Riches eternal and blessing supernal, From His precious hand I will receive.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Like the woman at the well, I was seeking For things that would not satisfy; And then I heard my Saviour speaking: "Draw from My well that never shall run dry."

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Fill my cup Lord, I lift it up, Lord! Come and quench this thirsting of my soul Bread of Heaven, feed me till I want no more, Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: As the hart pants for the water, so my soul Is thirsting for the Lord, And my heart cries out for the living God, Fill my cup, feed my soul with Thy word.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: There are millions in the world who are seeking The pleasure earthly things afford, But none can match the wondrous treasure That I found in Jesus Christ my Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: God sent His Son, they called Him Jesus, He came to love, heal and forgive, He lived and died and brought me pardon, An empty tomb is there to prove my Saviour lives.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Because He lives, I can face tomorrow, Because He lives, all fear is gone, Because I know, He holds my future, And life is worth a living just because He lives.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: How sweet to hold a new born baby, And feel the pride and joy He gives, But greater still the calm assurance. This child can face uncertain days, because He lives.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: And then one day I'll cross the river, I'll fight life's final war and pass; And then as death gave way to victory, I'll see the light of glory 'cause I know my Jesus lives.

title: THIS GLORIOUS DAY THERE'S NEVER BEEN A DAY LIKE THIS DAY TO ME, THERE'S NEVER BEEN A DAY LIKE THIS DAY I SEE, THERE'S NEVER BEEN A LIGHT THAT SHINES SO BRIGHT LIKE THIS DAY, THIS GLORIOUS DAY.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: O worship the King, All glorious above, O gratefully sing His power and His love; Our Shield and our Defender, The Ancient of Days, Pavilioned in splendour, And girded with praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: O tell of His might, O sing of His grace, Whose robe is the light, Whose canopy space; His chariot of wrath The deep thunder clouds form, And dark is His path, On the wings of the storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Thy bountiful care, What tongue can recite? It breathes in the air, It shines in the light, It streams from the hills, It descends to the plain, And sweetly distils In the dew and the rain.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Frail children of dust, As feeble as frail; In Thee do we trust, Nor find Thee to fail; Thy mercies how tender, How firm to the end! Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer and Friend.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: O measureless might Ineffable love, While angels delight, To hymn Thee above, The humbler creation. Though feeble there lays, With true adoration, Shall sing to Thy praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 1

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Man shall not live, by bread alone, But by every word That proceed from the mouth of the Lord, Hal-le-lu-jah!

lyrics.label: Verse 3

title: ALL HAIL KING JESUS ALL HAIL KING JESUS, ALL HAIL EMMANUEL, KING OF KINGS, LORD OF LORDS, BRIGHT, MORNING STAR; AND THROUGHOUT ETERNITY, I'M GOING TO PRAISE HIM, AND FOREVERMORE, I WILL REIGN WITH HIM.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Know ye not, know ye not, ye are a temple? Know ye not, know ye not, ye are a temple? Know ye not, know ye not, ye are a temple? Ye are the temple of the Holy Ghost.

lyrics.content: Yes we know, yes we know we are the temple, Yes we know, yes we know we are the temple, Yes we know, yes we know we are the temple, We are the temple of the Holy Ghost.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Full of praise, full of power, full of glory, Full of praise, full of power, full of glory, Full of praise, full of power, full of glory, I am a temple of the Holy Ghost.

title: HE WILL NOT START ANYTHING HE WILL NOT START ANYTHING HE CANNOT FINISH, HE WILL NOT START ANYTHING HE CANNOT FINISH, IF HE HAS SAVED YOUR SOUL, THEN HE WILL MAKE YOU WHOLE; HE WILL NOT START ANYTHING HE CANNOT FINISH.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Silent night, holy night, All is calm, all is bright Round the gentle mother and Child, Holy Infant, tender and mild, Sleep in heavenly peace, Sleep in heavenly peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Silent night, holy night, Shepherds quake at the sight, Wisemen ponder Heaven's bright star, Angels singing their "Hallelujah, Christ the Saviour is born, Christ the Saviour is born."

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Silent night, holy night, Son of God, lend Thy light, With the host we joyfully sing, Glory, honour, to Jesus our King, Christ the Saviour is born, Christ the Saviour is born.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I am so glad that our Father in Heaven Tells of His love in the Book He has given; Wonderful things in the Bible I see; This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I am so glad that Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me; I am so glad that Jesus loves me, Jesus loves even me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Though I forget Him and wander away, Still He doth love me wherever I stray, Back to His dear loving arms would I flee, When I remember that Jesus loves me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: O, if there's only one song I can sing, When in His beauty I see, -the great King, This shall my song in eternity be: "O what a wonder that Jesus loves me!"

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Jesus loves me, and I know I love Him; Love brought Him down my poor soul to redeem Yes, it was love made Him die on the cross, O, I am certain that Jesus loves me!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: If one should ask of me, how can I tell? Glory to Jesus, I know very well! God's Holy Spirit with mine doth agree, Constantly witnessing, "Jesus loves me!"

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: In this assurance I find sweetest rest, Trusting in Jesus I know I am blest; Satan, dismayed, from my soul now doth flee, When I just tell him that Jesus loves me!

title: THIS WORLD IS NOT MY HOME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: This world is not my home, I'm just a passing through; My treasures are laid up, Somewhere beyond the blue; The angels beckon me From Heaven's open door, And I can't feel at home In this world anymore.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: O Lord you know I have no friend like You, If Heaven is not my home, Then Lord what will I do? The angels beckon me From Heaven's open door, And I can't feel at home In this world anymore.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: They're all expecting me, And that's one thing I know; I fixed it up with Jesus Many years ago; I know He'll see me through, Though I am weak and poor, And I can't feel at home In this world anymore.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Just over in the gloryland, We'll live eternally; The saints on every hand Are shouting "victory" The songs of sweetest praise Drift back from Heaven's shore, And I can't feel at home In this world anymore.

title: UP FROM THE GRAVE HE AROSE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Low in the grave He lay, Jesus, my Saviour! Waiting the coming day, Jesus, my Lord!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Up from the grave He arose, With a mighty triumph o'er His foes; He arose, a Victor, from the dark domain, And He lives forever with His saints to reign, He arose! He arose! Hallelujah! Christ arose!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Vainly they watched His bed, Jesus, my Saviour! Vainly they sealed the dead, Jesus, my Lord!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Death cannot keep his Prey, Jesus, my Saviour! He tore the bars away, Jesus, my Lord!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, Ye soldier of the cross; Lift high His royal banner, It must not suffer loss. From victory unto victory, His army He shall lead, Till every foe is vanquished And Christ is Lord indeed.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, The trumpet call obey; Forth to the mighty conflict, In this His glorious day. Ye that are men now serve Him, Against unnumbered foes; Let courage rise with danger And strength to strength oppose.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, Stand in His strength alone; The arm of flesh will fail you, Ye dare not trust your own. Put on the gospel armour, And watching unto prayer, Where duty calls or danger, Be never wanting there.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, The strife will not be long; This day the noise of battle, The next the victor's song. To him that overcometh, A crown of life shall be, He with the King of glory Shall reign eternally.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: God's attributes were manifested To His bride in this last age, We have caught the revelation By the last prophet's message; And we know who we are, and what we're raised up for, Praise the Lord, for the Original Life.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: The Original Life, the Original Seed, The Original Word is what I believe, The Son of man is revealed, The seventh seal will be unveiled, The Original Life, the Original Seed.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: We are the Word made flesh today, This is what the scriptures say, And our names are seen within, Redeemed and perfect without sin; Yes, we are anointed and we are inspired.... By our God, who's the Original Life.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Our eyes of understanding, He has opened up at last; And sweet victory is ours, Who were chained down in the past; True jubilee has sounded, and we have responded To our God, who's the Original Life.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: We are called unto adoption, Full authority and power, Sleeping saints will wake and join us, For translation in this hour; Gentiles day soon will be over, glory, hallelujah To our God, who's the Original Life.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: My Jesus I love Thee, I know Thou art mine, For Thee all the follies of sin I resign; My gracious Redeemer, my Saviour art Thou; If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus 'tis now.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I love Thee because Thou hast first loved me, And purchased my pardon on Calvary's tree; I love Thee for wearing the thorns on Thy brow; If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus 'tis now.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: In mansions of glory and endless delight, I'll ever adore Thee in Heaven so bright; I'll sing with the glittering crown on my brow; If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus 'tis now.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: We are heirs of the Father, We are joint-heirs with the Son; We are people of His kingdom: We are family, we are one.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: We are washed, We are sanctified, We are cleansed by His blood, We are born of the Spirit, We are children of the LORD.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: We are members of His body, We are objects of His love. We are partakers of His holiness, We are citizens of Heaven above.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: We are partakers of His suffering, We are partakers of His grace; We shall meet Him to be like Him, We shall see Him face to face.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: We are longing for His coming, We are looking to the skies; We are watching, we are waiting, We shall dwell with Him, we shall rise.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: We shall reign with Him forever, Men and angels shout and sing; For dominion has been given, To the family of the King.

title: I DON'T KNOW WHAT I'D DO

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I don't know what I'd do, I don't know what I'd do, I don't know what I'd do without the Lord; When I look around and see, All that He has done for me, I don't know what I'd do without the Lord;

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Without Him I can do nothing, Without Him I'd surely fail; Without Him I would be drifting Like a ship without a sail.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: So I'll ask Him to be my Pilot, His Word my compass and guide; Till I've anchored safely in glory, For without Him I'd drift with the tide.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Jesus, My Jesus, Do you know Him today? Please don't turn Him away; O,Jesus, my Jesus Without Him how lost I would be.

title: HE'S THE LORD OF GLORY BEHOLD WHAT MANNER OF MAN IS THIS, WHO STILLS THE RAGING SEA? HE HEALS THE SICK, THE LAME, THE HALT AND MAKES THE BLIND TO SEE. HE OPENS ALL THE PRISON DOORS AND SETS THE CAPTIVES FREE. BEHOLD WHAT MANNER OF MAN IS THIS, WHAT MANNER OF MAN IS HE?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: He's the Lord of glory, He's our Kinsman Redeemer, The Alpha and Omega, The Beginning and the End, His name is Wonderful, The Prince of Peace is He, He's our ever living Saviour, Throughout eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Behold what manner of Man is this, Who spoke to the woman at the well, Everlasting life I'll give to thee, Far richer than man can tell, And whosoever shall drink of the well, Shall live eternally. Behold what manner of Man is this, What manner of Man is He?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Behold what manner of Man is this, Who speaks to the lame and the halt? He says "Thy sins be forgiven thee, Take up thy bed and walk," He stands as the mighty Healer still, And cries "Come unto Me." Behold what manner of Man is this, What manner of Man is He?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Behold what manner of Man is this, Who stands between God and man? His eyes are as a flame of fire, His fan is in His hand, John saw Him in the seven churches, As the sun in brilliancy. Behold what manner of Man is this, What manner of Man is He?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Behold what manner of Man is this, Who sits on His heavenly throne, He rules and reigns from Heaven above His beloved and His own; He's the Lion of the tribe of Judah, The root of David is He. Behold what manner of Man is this, What manner of Man is He?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: You ask me why I'm happy, So I'll just tell you why: "Because my sins are gone;" And when I meet the scoffers Who ask me where they are, I say, "my sins are gone."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: They're underneath the blood On the cross of Calvary, As far-removed as darkness is from dawn, In the sea of God's forgetfulness, That's good enough for me, Praise God, my sins are gone.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I was at the old-time altar, Where God came in my heart, And now my sins are gone; The Lord took full possession, The Devil did depart, I'm glad my sins are gone.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: When Satan comes to tempt me, And tries to make me doubt, I say, "my sins are gone; You got me into trouble But Jesus got me out, I'm glad my sins are gone."

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: I'm living now for Jesus, I'm happy night and day, Because my sins are gone; My soul is filled with music, With all my heart I say, "I know my sins are gone."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Let's talk about Jesus, The King of kings is He, The Lord of lords, Supreme Through all eternity, The great I AM, the Way, The Truth, the Life, the Door, Let's talk about Jesus more and more.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Let's talk about Jesus, Let all the world proclaim The power and majesty, Of such a wondrous name The Babe of Bethlehem, The Bright and Morning Star, Let's sing His praises near and far.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Let's talk about Jesus, The Bread of Life is He. The Saviour of the world, The Man of Galilee, The Prophet, Priest and King, The Son of God is He, The Well of Living Water free.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Let's talk about Jesus, The Prince of Peace is He The Great Physician too, Down through all history, The Lily pure and white, The Rose of Sharon fair, The Shepherd of such tender care.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Let's talk about Jesus, The Rock of Ages He, The Lamb for sinners slain, That Man of Calvary, The great Emmanuel, The Word of God sublime, He is our Bridegroom so Divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: For a long time I travelled Down a long lonely road; My heart was so heavy in sin I sank low Then I heard about Jesus, What a wonderful hour; I'm so glad that I found out He could bring me out Through His saving power.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Thank God I am free, free, free From this world of sin; Washed in the blood of Jesus, I've been born again. Hallelujah! I'm saved, saved, saved By His wonderful grace. I'm so glad that I found out He could bring me out And show me the way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Like a bird out of prison That has taken its flight; Like a blind man whom God gave back his sight. Like a poor wretched beggar That's found fortune and fame. I'm so glad that I found out He could bring me out Through His holy name.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Making melody in our hearts; Making melody in our hearts; Making melody in our hearts Unto the King of kings.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Worship and adore Him Worship and adore Him; Making melody in our hearts, Unto the King of kings.

title: I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES OF THE LORD FOREVER, I WILL SING, I WILL SING; I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES OF THE LORD FOREVER, I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES OF THE LORD. WITH MY MOUTH SHALL I MAKE KNOWN THY FAITHFULNESS, THY FAITHFULNESS; WITH MY MOUTH SHALL I MAKE KNOWN THY FAITHFULNESS TO ALL GENERATIONS; I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES OF THE LORD FOREVER, I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES OF THE LORD.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: He paid a debt He did not owe, I owed a debt I could not pay, I needed someone to wash my sins away; And now I sing a brand new song, Amazing grace all day long, Christ Jesus paid a debt that I could never pay.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: He paid a debt at Calvary, He cleansed my soul and set me free, I'm glad that Jesus did all my sins erase; I now can sing a brand new song, Amazing grace all day tong, Christ Jesus paid a debt that I could never pay.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: One day He's coming back for me To live with Him eternally, Won't it be glorious to see Him on that day? I then will sing a brand new song, Amazing grace all day long, Christ Jesus paid a debt that I could never pay.

title: A MIGHTY FORTRESS IS OUR GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: A mighty fortress is our God, a bulwark never failing; Our Helper He amid the flood of mortal ills prevailing: For still our ancient foe doth seek to work us woe; His craft and power are great, and, armed with cruel hate, On earth is not his equal.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Did we in our own strength confide, our striving would be losing; Were not the right Man on our side, the Man of God's own choosing: Dost ask who that may be? -Christ Jesus, it is He! Lord Sabaoth is His name, from age to age the same, And He must win the battle.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: And though this world, with devils filled, should threaten to undo us, We will not fear, for God hath willed His truth to triumph through us: The prince of darkness grim, we tremble not for him; His rage we can endure, for lo, his doom is sure, One little word shall fell him.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: That word above all earthly powers, -no thanks to them abideth; The Spirit and the gifts are ours through Him who with us sideth: Let goods and kindred go, this mortal life also; The body they may kill: God's truth abideth still; His kingdom is forever.

title: THROUGH THE LOVE OF GOD OUR SAVIOUR

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Through the love of God our Saviour All will be well; Free and changeless is His favour, All, all is well. Precious is the blood that healed us, Perfect is the grace that sealed us, Strong the hand stretched forth to shield us, All will be well.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Though we pass through tribulation, All must be well. Ours is such a free salvation, All, all is well, Happy, still in God confiding, Fruitful, if in Christ abiding, Holy through the Spirit's guiding All must be well.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: We expect a bright tomorrow All will be well; Faith can sing through days of sorrow All, all is well. On our Father's love relying Jesus every need supplying, Or in living, or in dying, All must be well.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Lord, Lord, Lord, You've surely been good to me; Lord, Lord, Lord, You've surely been good to me; Lord, Lord, Lord, You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

lyrics.content: You saved my soul when I was lost, You've surely been good to me; You saved my soul when I was lost, You've surely been good to me; You saved my soul when I was lost, You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: You filled me with the Holy Ghost, You've surely been good to me; You filled me with the Holy Ghost, You've surely been good to me; You filled me with the Holy Ghost, You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: You healed my body when I was sick, You've surely been good to me; You healed my body when I was sick, You've surely been good to me; You healed my body when I was sick, You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

lyrics.content: Give me oil in my lamp, keep me burning, Give me oil in my lamp I pray, Give me oil in my lamp, keep me burning; Keep me burning 'til the break of day.

lyrics.content: Sing Hosanna! Sing Hosanna! Sing Hosanna to the King of kings! Sing Hosanna! Sing Hosanna! Sing Hosanna to the King of kings.

lyrics.content: We have come into His house To magnify His name and worship Him, We have come into His house To magnify His name and worship Him, We have come into His house To magnify His name and worship Christ the Lord; Worship Him, Christ the Lord.

lyrics.content: So forget about yourself, Concentrate on Him and worship Him; So forget about yourself, Concentrate on Him and worship Him; So forget about yourself, Concentrate on Him and worship Christ the Lord; Worship Him, Christ the Lord.

lyrics.content: Let us lift up holy hands, Magnify His name and worship Him; Let us lift up holy hands, Magnify His name and worship Him; Let us lift up holy hands, Magnify His name and worship Christ the Lord; Worship Him, Christ the Lord.

title: UNTIL YOU KNOW IF YOU COULD OWN ALL THE WORLD AND IT'S MONEY, YOU COULD PUT UP ENOUGH TO REACH THE SKIES ABOVE, IF YOU COULD KNOW EVERYTHING YOU WANT TO KNOW ABOUT MY FAITH, FRIEND, YOU'VE KNOWN NOTHING UNTIL YOU'VE KNOWN THE LOVE OF GOD.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Until you know the loving hand That reaches down to fallen man And picks him up above the plane Where he has trod; Until you know just how it feels To know that God is really real, You know nothing Until you know the love of God. If in your lifetime you could meet everybody, And you could call every name from here to yonder, If you've not come face to face with Jesus and His saving grace, Friend, you've known nothing until you've known the love of God.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I have decided to follow Jesus, No turning back, no turning back.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: The cross before me the world behind me, No turning back, no turning back.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Take this whole world but give me Jesus, No turning back, no turning back.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Though none go with me, still I will follow, No turning back, no turning back.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: My heart can sing when I pause to remember, A heart-ache here is but a stepping-stone Along the trail that's winding always upward; This troubled world is not my final home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: But until then, my heart will go on singing, Until then, with joy I'll carry on, Until the day mine eyes behold the city Until the day God calls me home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: The things of earth will dim and lose their value, If we recall, they're borrowed for awhile; And things of earth that cause the heart to tremble, Remember there, will only bring a smile.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: This weary world with all its toil and struggle May take its toll of misery and strife; The soul of man is like a waiting falcon, When it's released, it's destined for the sky.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Joy to the world, the Lord is come! Let earth receive her King; Let every heart prepare Him room, And heaven and nature sing, And heaven and nature sing, And heaven, and heaven, and nature sing.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Joy to the world, the Saviour reigns! Let men their songs employ; While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains Repeat the sounding joy, Repeat the sounding joy, Repeat, repeat, the sounding joy.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: No more let sins and sorrows grow, Nor thorns infest the ground; He comes to make His Far as the curse is found, blessings flow Far as the curse is found, Far as, far as, the curse is found.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: He rules the world with truth and grace, And makes the nations prove The glories of His righteousness, And wonders of His love, And wonders of His love, And wonders, and wonders, of His love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Wonderful story of love Tell it to me again; Wonderful story of love; Wake the immortal strain! Angels with rapture announce it, Shepherds with wonder receive it; Sinner, O won't you believe it? Wonderful story of love.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Wonderful! Wonderful! Wonderful! Wonderful story of love!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Wonderful story of love, Though you are far away; Wonderful story of love, Still He doth call today; Calling from Calvary's mountain, Down from the crystal bright fountain, E'en from the dawn of creation,

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Wonderful story of love. Wonderful story of love, Jesus provides the rest; Wonderful story of love, For all the pure and blest; Rest in those mansions above us, With those who've gone on before us, Singing the rapturous chorus: Wonderful story of love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1

lyrics.content: Will you be among? When we sing on that day, Joy, joy, joy, Hallelujah joy, hallelujah joy We shall sing on that day.
