lyrics.content: I will be among When we sing on that day, Joy, joy, joy, Hallelujah joy, hallelujah joy We shall sing on that day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Be gone unbelief my Saviour is near And for my relief will surely appear; By prayer let me wrestle, and He will perform, With Christ in the vessel, I smile at the storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Though, dark be my way! Since He is my Guide: 'Tis mine to obey, 'tis His to provide; Though cisterns be broken and creatures all fail, The word He hath spoken shall surely prevail.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: His love in time past forbids me to think He'll leave me at last in trouble to sink; While each Ebenezer I have in review Confirms His good pleasure to help me quite through.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Why should I complain of wants and distress, Temptation or pain? He told me no less; The heirs of salvation, I know from His word, Through much tribulation, must follow the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Since all that I meet shall work for my good, The bitter is sweet, the medicine food; Though painful at present, 'twill cease before long, And then O how pleasant the conqueror's song.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Jesus, lover of my soul, let me to Thy bosom fly, While the billows near me roll, while the tempest still is high. Hide me, O my Saviour, hide, till the storm of life is past; Safe into the haven guide; O receive my soul at last!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Other refuge have I none, hangs my helpless soul on Thee; Leave, O, leave me not alone! Still support and comfort me; All my trust on Thee is stayed, all my help from Thee I bring; Cover my defenceless head with the shadow of Thy wing.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Wilt Thou not regard my call? Wilt Thou not accept my prayer? Lo! I sink, I faint, I fall-Lo! On Thee I cast my care; Reach me out Thy gracious hand! While I of Thy strength receive, Hoping against hope I stand, dying, and behold, I live.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Thou, O Christ, art all I want, more than all in Thee I find; Raise the fallen, cheer the faint, heal the sick, and lead the blind. Just and holy is Thy name, I am all unrighteousness; Vile and full of sin I am; Thou art full of truth and grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Plenteous grace with Thee is found, -grace to pardon all my sin; Let the healing streams abound, make and keep me pure within. Thou of life the Fountain art, freely let me take of Thee; Spring Thou up within my heart; rise to all eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee! Even though it be a cross that raiseth me; Still all my song shall be, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Though like the wanderer, the sun gone down, Darkness be over me, my rest a stone; Yet in my dreams I'd be, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: There let the way appear, steps unto Heaven: All that Thou sendest me, in mercy giv'n: Angels to beckon me, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Then, with my waking thoughts, bright with Thy praise, Out of my stony grief, Bethel I'll raise; So by my woes to be, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Or if on joyful wing, cleaving the sky, Sun, moon and stars forgot, upward I fly; Still all my song shall be, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

title: THE GOODNESS OF JESUS WHEN I THINK OF THE GOODNESS OF JESUS AND ALL HE HAS DONE FOR ME THEN MY SOUL CRIES OUT "HALLELUJAH! PRAISE GOD FOR SAVING ME!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: O the judgment day is coming, What an awful day it will be! Christ forever is my refuge, Rock of Ages cleft for me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: O, my loving brother, When the world's on fire Don't you want God's bosom To be your pillow? Hide me over in the Rock of Ages; Rock of Ages cleft for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: At the sounding of the trumpet, At the dawning of the day, Worldly pleasures with its treasures, Shall forever pass away.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Poor lost sinners will be crying For the home they'll never see; But the ransomed will be singing: "Rock of Ages cleft for me."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I've been to the water and I've been baptized; I've been washed in the blood of the Lamb; I've been changed from the creature That I once was, And "Redeemed" is now my name.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I've been changed; I've been reborn, All my life has been rearranged; What a difference it makes When the Lord has His way All my life, praise God, has been changed.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Though my sins were as scarlet, they are white as snow; I was bound but today I am free; I was lost in the darkness But now I'm found; I was blind but now I see.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: When at last in His presence I stand above, He will wipe every tear from my eyes; And I'll thank Him for giving A wretch like me, A new home beyond the sky

title: WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN: WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN, JUST PRAISING THE LORD: JUST PRAISING THE LORD, WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN: WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN, IN ONE ACCORD: IN ONE ACCORD. SOMETHING GOOD IS ALREADY HAPPENING, SOMETHING BETTER IS IN STORE. WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN: WE ARE TOGETHER AGAIN, JUST PRAISING THE LORD: JUST PRAISING THE LORD.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Jerusalem on high My song and city is, My home whene'er I die The center of my bliss.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: O happy place! When shall I be, my God with Thee, To see Thy face?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Earth's but a sorry tent, Pitched but a few frail days, A short leased tenement; Heaven's still my song, my praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: There should temptations cease, My frailities there should end. There should I rest in peace In the arms of my best friend.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: There dwells my Lord, my King, Judged here unfit to live; There angels to Him sing, And lowly homage give.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: The patriarchs of old There from their travels cease: The prophets there behold: The Harpers I might hear Harping on harps of gold.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Some glad morning when this life is o'er I'll fly away, To a home on God's celestial shore, I'll fly away.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I'll fly away, O glory, I'll fly away; When I die, hallelujah, by and by I'll fly away.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: When the shadow, of this life has grown, I'll fly away; Like a bird from prison bars has flown, I'll fly away.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Just a few more weary days and then, I'll fly away; To a land where joys shall never end, I'll fly away.

title: 'TIS SO SWEET TO TRUST IN JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: 'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus, Just to take Him at His word; Just to rest upon His promise, Just to know, "Thus saith the Lord."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him! How I've proved Him o'er and o'er! Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus! O, for grace to trust Him more!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: O, how sweet to trust in Jesus, Just to trust His cleansing blood; Just in simple faith to plunge me 'Neath the healing, cleansing flood!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus, Just from sin and self to cease; Just from Jesus simply taking Life and rest, and joy, and peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: I'm so glad I learned to trust Thee, Precious Jesus, Saviour, Friend; And I know that Thou art with me, Wilt be with me to the end.

title: O, FOR A THOUSAND TONGUES TO SING

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: O, for a thousand tongues to sing My great Redeemer's praise, The glories of my God and King, The triumphs of His grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: My gracious Master and my God, Assist me to proclaim To spread through all the earth abroad, The honours of Thy name.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Jesus! The name that charms our fears, That bids our sorrows cease; 'Tis music in the sinner's ears, 'Tis life, and health and peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: He breaks the powers of cancelled sin, He sets the prisoner free, His blood can make the foulest clean, His blood avails for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Hear Him, ye deaf; His praise, ye dumb, Your loosened tongues employ; Ye blind, behold your Saviour come; And leap, ye lame, for joy.

title: BE GLAD IN THE LORD AND REJOICE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, All ye that are upright in heart; And ye that have made Him your choice, Bid sadness and sorrow depart.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Rejoice!... Rejoice!... Be glad in the Lord and rejoice! Rejoice!... Rejoice!... Be glad in the Lord and rejoice.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Be joyful, for He is the Lord On earth and in Heaven, Supreme; He fashions and rules by His word; The "Mighty" and "Strong" to redeem.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: What though in the conflict for right Your enemies almost prevail! God's armies, just hid from your sight Are more than the foes which assail.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Though darkness surround you by day, Your sky by the night be overcast; Let nothing your spirit dismay, But trust till the danger is past.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, His praises proclaiming in songs; With harp, and with organ, and voice, The loud hallelujahs prolong!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Ye thirsty for God, to Jesus give ear, And take, through His blood, a power to draw near; His kind invitation ye sinners embrace, Accepting salvation, salvation by grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Sent down from above, Who governs the skies, In vehement love to sinners He cries, Drink into my Spirit, who happy would be, And all things inherit by coming to Me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: O Saviour of all, Thy Word we believe! And come at Thy call, Thy grace to receive; The blessing is given wherever Thou art. The earnest of heaven is love in the heart.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: To us at Thy feet the Comforter give, Who gasp to admit Thy Spirit, and live; The weakest believers acknowledge for Thine, And fill us with rivers of water divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: When the host of Israel, led by God, Round the walls of Jericho softly trod, Trusting in the Lord, they felt the conqueror's tread By faith they saw the victory ahead.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Victory ahead! Victory ahead! Through the blood of Jesus, victory ahead, Trusting in the Lord, I hear the conqueror's tread; By faith I see the victory ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: David with a shepherd's sling and five stones, Met the giant on the field all alone; Trusting in the Lord, he knew what God had said; By faith he saw the victory ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Daniel prayed unto the Lord thrice each day, Then unto the lion's den led the way; Trusting in the Lord, he did not fear or dread; By faith he saw the victory ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Often with the carnal mind I was tried, Asking for deliverance, oft I cried; Trusting in the Lord, I reckoned I was dead; By faith I see the victory ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: When, like those who've gone before to that land, By death's river cold and dark I shall stand; Trusting in the Lord, I will not fear or dread, By faith I see the victory ahead.

title: HE IS LORD HE IS LORD; HE IS LORD. HE HAS RISEN FROM THE DEAD AND HE IS LORD. EVERY KNEE SHALL BOW, EVERY TONGUE CONFESS THAT JESUS CHRIST IS LORD.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I need Thee every hour; Most gracious Lord; No tender voice like Thine Can peace afford.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I need Thee, O, I need Thee; Every hour I need Thee; O bless me now my Saviour;

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I come to Thee. I need Thee every hour; Stay Thou near by Temptations lose their power When Thou art near.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I need Thee every hour; In joy or pain; Come quickly and abide; Or life is vain.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: I need Thee every hour; Teach me Thy will; And Thy rich promises In me fulfil.

title: HAPPINESS IS TO KNOW THE SAVIOUR

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Happiness is to know the Saviour, Living a life within His favour, Having a change in my behaviour. Happiness is the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Happiness is the creation, Jesus and me in close relation; Having a part in His salvation, Happiness is the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Happiness is to be forgiven, Living a life that's worth living, Taking a trip that leads to Heaven; Happiness is the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Redemption! O, wonderful story, Glad message for you and for me; That Jesus has purchased our pardon, And paid all the debt on the tree.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Believe it, O sinner, believe it; Receive the glad message -'tis true; Trust now in the crucified Saviour, Salvation He offers to you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: From death into life He hath brought us, And made us by grace sons of God; A fountain is opened for all sinners; O, wash and be cleansed in the blood!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: No longer shall sin have dominion, Though present to tempt and annoy; For Christ, in His blessed redemption, The power of sin shall destroy.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Accept now God's offer of mercy; To Jesus, O hasten today; For He will receive him that cometh, And never will turn him away.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Along life's way, I stumble in the darkness, My blinded eyes had caused my feet to roam; I met the Lord who spoke to me so sweetly, "I'll walk with you, and I will see you through."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Come walk with me, the way is strait and narrow, Come walk with me, I cannot walk alone; For the road is rough and there are many dangers, Come walk with me, come and see me through.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: So now I walk with Christ my blessed Saviour, I do not fear, for I am not alone; He guides me through all life with all its sorrows, And someday soon, He'll see me safely home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Faith of our fathers living still, Inspite of dungeon, fire, and sword: O how our hearts beat high with joy When e'er we hear that glorious word: "Faith of our fathers," holy faith! We will be true to thee till death.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Our fathers chained in prisons dark, Were still in heart and conscience free; How sweet will be their children's fate! If they, like them, could die for thee: Faith of our fathers, holy faith! We will be true to thee till death.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Faith of our fathers! We will strive To win all nations unto thee, And through the truth that comes from God Mankind shall then be truly free: Faith of our fathers, holy faith! We will be true to thee till death.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Faith of our fathers! We will love, Both friends and foes in all our strife; And preach thee, too, as love knows how, By kindly word and virtuous life: Faith of our fathers, holy faith! We will be true to thee till death.

title: ALL IS WELL ALL IS WELL, ALL IS WELL; WE HAVE HEARD THE MESSAGE: "SHALOM" ALL IS WELL; THERE IS A PLACE OF PERFECT REST BEHIND THE INNER VEIL, SO REST, LITTLE BRIDE REST, ALL IS WELL.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Earthly pleasures vainly call me; I would be like Jesus; Nothing worldly shall enthral me; I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Be like Jesus,' tis my song, In the home and in the throng; Be like Jesus, all day long! I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: He has broken every fetter, I would be like Jesus; That my soul may serve Him better, I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: All the way from earth to glory, I would be like Jesus; Telling o'er and o'er the story, I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: That in Heaven He may meet me, I would be like Jesus; That His words, "well done", may greet me, I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Holy! Holy! Holy! Lord God Almighty! Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee; Holy! Holy! Holy! Merciful and mighty! God in Christ Jesus, blessed unity!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Holy! Holy! Holy! All the saints adore Thee, Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea; Cherubim and Seraphim falling down before Thee, Which wert, and art, and evermore shall be.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Holy! Holy! Holy! Though the darkness hide Thee, Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see, Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Holy! Holy! Holy! Lord God Almighty! All Thy works shall praise Thy name in earth, and sky, and sea; Holy! Holy! Holy! Merciful and mighty! God in Christ Jesus, blessed unity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go! Anywhere He leads me in this world below! Anywhere without Him dearest joys would fade; Anywhere with Jesus I am not afraid.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Anywhere! Anywhere! Fear I cannot know; Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Anywhere with Jesus I am not alone! Other friends may fail me, He is still my own! Though His hand may lead me over dreary ways, Anywhere with Jesus is a house of praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Anywhere with Jesus over land and sea, Telling soul in darkness of salvation free; Ready as He summons me to go or stay, Anywhere with Jesus when He points the way!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Anywhere with Jesus I can go to sleep, When the gloomy shadows round about me creep! Knowing I shall waken never more to roam; Anywhere with Jesus will be "home, sweet home."

title: HE'S CHANGING ME FROM GLORY TO GLORY HE'S CHANGING ME, CHANGING ME! CHANGING ME! HIS LIKENESS AND IMAGE TO PERFECT IN ME, THE LOVE OF GOD SHOWN TO THE WORLD; FOR HE'S CHANGING, CHANGING ME, FROM EARTHLY THINGS TO THE HEAVENLY, HIS LIKENESS AND IMAGE TO PERFECT IN ME, THE LOVE OF GOD SHOWN TO THE WORLD.
CREATE IN ME A CLEAN HEART

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a right spirit within me; Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a right spirit within me. Cast me not away from Thy presence O Lord, And take not Thy Holy Spirit from me, Restore unto me the joy of salvation, And renew a right spirit within me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I like the old-time way I like the old-time way I like the old-time preaching, singing, shouting, praying I like the old time way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I like the old time living, dancing, singing, praying, I like the old time way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I sing about my Saviour everywhere I go, Everywhere I go, everywhere I go; I sing about my Saviour everywhere I go For there's joy, joy in my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Lord speak to me that I may speak In living echoes of Thy tone, As Thou hast sought, so let me seek Thy erring children lost and lone.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: O, use me Lord, use even me Just as Thou wilt, and when, and where.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: O, lead me, Lord, that I may lead The wandering and the wavering feet O, feed me, Lord, that I may feed Thy hungering ones with manna sweet.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: O, strengthen me, that while I stand Firm on the rock and strong in Thee, I may stretch out a loving hand To wrestlers with the troubled sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: O, fill me with Thy fullness Lord Until my very heart o'erflow In kindly thought and glowing word Thy love to tell, Thy praise to show.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: O, give Thine sweet rest to me That I may speak with soothing power A word in season, as from Thee To weary ones in needful hour.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: Lord, bend my will and make it Thine My inner man broken and meek Living my all only for Thee Until Thy blessed face I see.

title: I'LL SEE YOU IN THE RAPTURE

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I'll see you in the rapture, I'll see you in the rapture, I'll see you at that meeting in the air; There with our blessed Saviour We'll live and reign forever I'll see you in the rapture some sweet day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: If we never meet again on this earth my precious friend, If to God you have been true and lived above all sin; Then for us there'll be a greeting, for there's going to be a meeting I'll see you in the rapture some sweet day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: To my loved ones let me say, there will surely come a day, When the Lord will come again and catch His bride away; So get ready now to meet Him and with hallelujah greet Him! I'll see you in the rapture some sweet day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Immortal, invisible, God only wise, In light inaccessible hid from our eyes, Most blessed most glorious, the Ancient of Days, Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise. Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light, Nor wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might; Thy Justice like mountains high soaring above Thy clouds, which are fountains of goodness and love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: To all life Thou givest to both great and small; In all life Thou livest, the true life of all; We blossom and flourish, as leaves on the tree, Then wither and perish,-but nought changeth Thee

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Great Father of Glory, pure Father of Light, Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight: All laud we would render: O help us to see 'Tis only the splendour of light hideth Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Loving Saviour, hear my cry; Hear my cry, hear my cry: Trembling, to Thine arms I fly! O, save me at the cross! I have sinned, but Thou hast died; Thou hast died, Thou hast died; In Thy mercy let me hide, O, save me at the cross!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Lord Jesus, receive me, No more would I grieve Thee; Now, blessed Redeemer, O, save me at the cross

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Though I perish I will pray, I will pray, I will pray; Thou of life the loving way; O, save me at the cross! Thou hast said Thy grace is free, Grace is free, grace is free, Have compassion, Lord on me; O, save me at the cross!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Wash me in Thy cleansing blood, Cleansing blood, cleansing blood, Plunge me now beneath the flood; O, save me at the cross! Only faith will pardon bring, Pardon bring, pardon bring, To that faith to Thee I cling; O, save me at the cross!

title: CAST THY BURDEN ON THE LORD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Cast thy burden on the Lord, Only lean upon His Word; Thou wilt soon have cause to bless His eternal faithfulness.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: He sustains thee by His hand, He enables thee to stand; Those whom Jesus once hath loved From His grace are never moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Human counsels come to naught; That shall stand which God hath wrought; His compassion, love, and power Are the same forevermore.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Heav'n and earth may pass away, God's free grace shall not decay; He hath promised to fulfil All the pleasure of His will.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Jesus, Guardian of Thy flock, Be Thyself our constant Rock; Make us, by Thy powerful hand Strong as Zion's mountain stand

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Be still, my soul: the Lord is on thy side. Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain. Leave to thy God to order and provide; In every change, He faithful will remain. Be still, my soul: thy best, thy heavenly Friend Through thorny ways leads to a joyful end.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Be still, my soul: thy God doth undertake To guide the future, as He has the past. Thy hope, thy confidence let nothing shake; All now mysterious shall be bright at last. Be still, my soul: the waves and winds still know His voice Who ruled them while He dwelt below.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Be still, my soul: when dearest friends depart, And all is darkened in the vale of tears, Then shalt thou better know His love, His heart; Who comes to soothe thy sorrow and thy fears. Be still, my soul: thy Jesus can repay From His own fullness all He takes away.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Be still, my soul: the hour is hastening on When we shall be forever with the Lord. When disappointment, grief and fear are gone, Sorrow forgot, love's purest joys restored. Be still, my soul: when change and tears are past All safe and blessed we shall meet at last.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Be still, my soul: begin the song of praise On earth, be living to Thy Lord on high; Acknowledge Him in all thy words and ways, So shall He view thee with a well pleased eye. Be still, my soul: the sun of life divine Through passing clouds shall but more brightly shine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: All glory, laud and honour, To Thee, Redeemer, King, To whom the lips of children Made sweet hosannas ring. Thou art the King of Israel, Thou David's royal Son, Who in the Lord's name comest, The King and Blessed One.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: The company of angels Are praising Thee on high, And mortal men and all things Created make reply. The people of the Hebrews With palms before Thee went; Our praise and prayer and anthems Before Thee we present.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: To Thee, before Thy passion, They sang their hymns of praise; To Thee, now high exalted, Our melody we raise. Thou didst accept their praises; Accept the praise we bring, Who in all good delightest, Thou good and gracious King.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: There is only one God, There is only one King There is only one Body That is why we sing:

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Bind us together, Lord Bind us together With cord that cannot be broken; Bind us together, Lord Bind us together, Lord Bind us together in love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Made for the glory of God, Purchased by His precious Son. Born with the right to be clean, For Jesus the victory has won.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: We are the family of God, We are the promise divine, We are God's chosen desire, We are the glorious new race.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: There's a line that's drawn by rejecting our Lord, Where the call of His Spirit is lost And you hurry along with the pleasure-mad throng Have you counted, have you counted the cost?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Have you counted the cost, if your soul should be lost, Though you gain the whole world for your own? Even now it may be that the line you have crossed, Have you counted, have you counted the cost?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: You may barter your hope of eternity's morn, For a moment of joy at the most, For the glitter of sin and the things it will win- Have you counted, have you counted the cost?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: While the door of His mercy is open to you, Ere the depth of your folly you come Won't you come and be healed, won't you whisper, I yield? I have counted, I have counted the cost.

title: GUIDE ME, O THOU GREAT JEHOVAH

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Guide me, O Thou great Jehovah, Pilgrim through this barren land. I am weak, but Thou art mighty; Hold me with Thy powerful hand. Bread of Heaven Feed me till I want no more; Bread of Heaven Feed me till I want no more.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Open now the crystal fountain, Whence the healing stream doth flow; Let the fiery, cloudy pillar Lead me all my journey through. Strong Deliverer Be Thou still my strength and shield; Strong Deliverer Be Thou still my strength and shield.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Lord, I trust Thy mighty power, Wondrous are Thy works of old; Thou deliver'st Thine from thralldom, Who for naught themselves had sold: Thou didst conquer Sin, and Satan and the grave, Thou didst conquer Sin, and Satan and the grave.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: When I tread the verge of Jordan, Bid my anxious fears subside; Bear me through the swelling torrent, Land me safe on Canaan's side. Songs of praises, I will ever give to Thee; Songs of praises, I will ever give to Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Savior come we long to see Thee, Long to dwell with Thee above; And to know in full communion All the sweetness of Thy love. Come Lord Jesus, Take Thy waiting people home; Come Lord Jesus, Take Thy waiting people home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer! Sing, O earth, His wonderful love proclaim! Hail Him! Hail Him! Highest archangels in glory; Strength and honour give to His holy name! Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard His children, In His arms He carries them all day long;

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Praise Him! Praise Him! Tell of His excellent greatness; Praise Him! Praise Him ever in joyful song!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer! For our sins He suffered, and bled and died; He, -our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation, Hail Him! Hail Him! Jesus the Crucified; Sound His praises! Jesus who bore our sorrows, Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong;

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer! Heavenly portals, loud with hosannas ring! Jesus, Saviour, reigneth forever and ever; Crown Him! Crown Him! Prophet, and Priest, and King! Christ is coming over the world victorious, Power and glory unto the Lord belong;

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Come, ye sinners, poor and needy, Weak and wounded, sick and sore; Jesus ready stands to save you, Full of pity, love and power.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I will arise and go to Jesus, He will embrace me in His arms; In the arms of my dear Saviour, O there are ten thousand charms.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Come, ye thirsty, come, and welcome, God's free bounty glorify; True belief and true repentance, Every grace that brings you nigh.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Come, ye weary, heavy laden, Lost and ruined by the fall; If you tarry till you're better, You will never come at all.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: View Him prostrate in the garden; On the ground your Saviour lies. On the bloody tree behold Him; Sinner, will this not suffice?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Lo, the incarnate God ascended, Pleads the merit of His blood: Venture on Him, venture wholly, Let no other trust intrude.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: Let not conscience make you linger, Not of fitness fondly dream; All the fitness He requireth Is to feel your need of Him.

title: PRAISE TO THE LORD, THE ALMIGHTY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation! O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation! All ye who hear, now to His temple draw near; Praise Him in glad adoration.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth, Shelters thee under His wings, yea, so gently sustaineth! Hast thou not seen how thy desires e'er have been Granted in what He ordaineth?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, who hath fearfully, wondrously, made thee; Health hath vouchsafed and, when heedlessly falling, hath stayed thee. What need or grief ever hath failed of relief? Wings of His mercy did shade thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper thy work and defend thee; Surely His goodness and mercy here daily attend thee. Ponder anew what the Almighty can do, If with His love He befriend thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, who, when tempests their warfare are waging, Who, when the elements madly around thee are raging, Biddeth them cease, turneth their fury to peace, Whirlwinds and waters assuaging.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, who, when darkness of sin is abounding, Who, when the godless do triumph, all virtue confounding, Sheddeth His light, chaseth the horrors of night, Saints with His mercy surrounding.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content: Praise to the Lord, O let all that is in me adore Him! All that hath life and breath, come now with praises before Him. Let the "AMEN!" sound from His people again, Gladly for all we adore Him.

title: BREATHE ON ME, BREATH OF GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Breathe on me, breath of God, Fill me with life anew, That I may love what Thou dost love, And do what Thou wouldst do.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Breathe on me, breath of God, Until my heart is pure, Until with Thee I will one will, To do and to endure.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Breathe on me, breath of God, Till I am wholly Thine Until this earthly part of me Glows with Thy fire divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Breathe on me, breath of God, So shall I constant be, But live with Thee the perfect life Of Thine eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Jesus, Friend of little children, Be a Friend to me; Take my hand and ever keep me Close to Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Teach me how to grow in goodness, Daily as I grow; Thou hast been a Child and surely Thou dost know.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Step by step, O, lead me onward, Upward into youth; Wiser, stronger, still becoming In Thy truth.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Never leave me nor forsake me, Ever be my Friend; For I need Thee from life's dawning To its end.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Abide with me; fast falls the eventide; The darkness deepens; Lord with me abide! When other helpers fail, and comforts flee, Help of the helpless, O, abide with me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day; Earth's joys grow dim, its glories pass away; Change and decay in all around I see! O Thou who changest not, abide with me!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I need Thy presence every passing hour; What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power? Who like Thyself my guide and stay can be? Through cloud and sunshine, O, abide with me!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless; Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness; Where is death's sting? Where, grave, thy victory? I'll triumph still if Thou abide with me!

title: LET US WITH A GLADSOME MIND

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Let us with a gladsome mind Praise the Lord for He is kind; For His mercies shall endure, Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: He, with all-commanding might Filled the new-made world with light; For His mercies shall endure, Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: All things living He doth feed, His full hand supplies their need; For His mercies shall endure, Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Le us, then, with gladsome mind Praise the Lord for He is kind; For His mercies shall endure, Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: There is a balm in Gilead to make the wounded whole; There is a balm in Gilead to heal the sin-sick soul. Some times I feel discouraged, And think my work's in vain, But then the Holy Spirit Revives my soul again.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: There is a balm in Gilead to make the wounded whole; There is a balm in Gilead to heal the sin-sick soul. If you cannot preach like Peter, If you cannot pray like Paul, Just tell the love of Jesus, And say He died for all.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: As water to the thirsty, As beauty to the eyes, As strength that follows weakness, As Truth instead of lies, As songtime and springtime and summertime to be, So is my Lord, my living Lord, So is my Lord to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Like calm in place of clamour, Like peace that follows pain, Like meeting after parting, Like sunshine after rain, Like moonlight and starlight and sunlight on the sea, So is my Lord, my living Lord, So is my Lord to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: As sleep that follows fever, As gold instead of grey, As freedom after bondage, As sunrise to the day, As home to the traveller and all he longs to see, So is my Lord, my living Lord, So is my Lord to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Worthy, worthy is the Lamb Worthy, worthy is the Lamb Worthy, worthy is the Lamb That was slain.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Glory, Hallelujah! Praise Him Hallelujah! Glory Hallelujah! To the Lamb!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Saviour let Thy kingdom come! Now the power of sin consume; Bring Thy blest millennium, Holy Lamb.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Thus may we each moment feel, Love Him, serve Him, praise Him still, Till we all on Zion's hill See the Lamb.

title: LORD JESUS ONCE YOU SPOKE TO MEN

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Lord Jesus once You spoke to men Upon the mountain and the plain, O help us listen now as then And wonder at Your words again.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: We all have secret fears to face, Our minds and motives to amend. We seek Your truth, we need Your grace, Our living Lord and precious Friend.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: The gospel speaks and we receive Your light, Your love, Your own command. O, help us live what we believe, In daily word of heart and hand.

title: GOD OF GRACE AND GOD OF GLORY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: God of grace and God of glory, On Thy people pour Thy power; Crown Thine ancient church's story, Bring her bud to glorious flower. Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, For the facing of this hour, For the facing of this hour.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Lo, the hosts of evil 'round us Scorn Thy Christ, assail His ways; From the fears that long have bound us Free our hearts to faith and praise. Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, For the living of these days, For the living of these days.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Cure Thy children's warring madness, Bend our pride to Thy control; Shame our wanton, selfish gladness, Rich in things and poor in soul. Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, Lest we miss Thy kingdom's goal, Lest we miss Thy kingdom's goal.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Set our feet on lofty places, Gird our lives that they may be Armoured with all Christ-like graces In the fight to set men free. Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, That we fail not man nor Thee, That we fail not man nor Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Save us from weak resignation To the evils we deplore; Let the search for Thy salvation Be our glory evermore. Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, Serving Thee Whom we adore, Serving Thee Whom we adore.

title: GOD WILL TAKE CARE OF YOU

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Be not dismayed whatever betide, God will take care of you; Beneath His wings of love abide, God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: God will take care of you, Through everyday, o'er all the way; He will take care of you, God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Through days of trial when your heart doth fail, God will take care of you; When dangers fierce your path assail, God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: All you may need He will provide, God will take care of you; Nothing you ask will be denied, God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: No matter what may be the test, God will take care of you; Lean, weary one, upon His breast, God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord, Is laid for your faith in His excellent Word! What more can He say than to you He hath said, You, who unto Jesus for refuge have fled?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: In every condition, in sickness, in health; In poverty's vale, or abounding in wealth; At home and abroad, on the land, on the sea, As thy days may demand, shall thy strength ever be.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: "Fear not, I am with thee, O be not dismayed! For I am thy God, I will still give thee aid; I'll strengthen and help thee, and cause thee to stand Upheld by My gracious, omnipotent hand."

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: "When through the deep waters I call thee to go, The rivers of woe shall not thee overflow; For I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless, And sanctify to thee thy deepest distress." "When through fiery trials thy pathways shall lie, My grace, all sufficient, shall be thy supply; The flame shall not hurt thee; I only design Thy dross to consume, and thy gold to refine."

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: "Even down to old age all My people shall prove My sovereign, eternal, unchangeable love; And when hoary hairs shall their temples adorn Like lambs, they shall still in My bosom be borne." "The soul that on Jesus has leaned for repose, I will not, I will not desert to its foes;

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: That soul, though all hell should endeavour to shake, I'll never, no never, no never forsake!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Everybody ought to know , Everybody ought to know , Everybody ought to know , Who Jesus is Everybody ought to know , Everybody ought to know , Everybody ought to know , Who Jesus is

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: He's the Lily Of The Valley, He's the Bright And Morning Star, He's the Fairest of Ten Thousand, Everybody ought to know.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Everybody ought to love , Everybody ought to love , Everybody ought to love , Who Jesus is Everybody ought to love , Everybody ought to love , Everybody ought to love , Who Jesus is

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Everybody ought to tell , Everybody ought to tell , Everybody ought to tell , Who Jesus is Everybody ought to tell , Everybody ought to tell , Everybody ought to tell , Who Jesus is

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Everybody ought to sing , Everybody ought to sing , Everybody ought to sing , Glad praise to Him Everybody ought to sing , Everybody ought to sing , Everybody ought to sing , Glad praise to Him

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: On Zion's summit stood glorious A host by blood, numerous redeemed They hymned their King in strains divine: I heard the song and strove to join; I heard the song and strove to join.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Here all who suffered sword or flame For Jesus' truth or lovely name, Shout victory now and hail the Lamb: And bow before the great I AM; And bow before the great I AM.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: While everlasting ages roll Eternal love shall fest their soul, And scenes of bliss, forever new Rise in succession to their view; Rise in succession to their view.

title: I'VE FOUND THE PEARL OF GREATEST PRICE

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I've found the Pearl of Greatest Price, My heart doth sing for joy; And sing I must, for Christ is mine; Christ shall my song employ.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Christ is my Prophet, Priest and King; A Prophet full of light, My great High Priest before the throne, My King of heavenly might.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: For He indeed is Lord of lords, And He the King of kings; He is the Sun of Righteousness, With healing in His wings.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Christ is my peace; He died for me, For me He gave His blood; And as my wondrous Sacrifice, Offered Himself to God.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Christ Jesus is my All-in-All, My Comfort and my Love, My Life below, and He shall be My Joy and Crown above.

title: I'VE GOT PEACE LIKE A RIVER

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I have peace like a river, peace like a river, I have peace like a river in my soul; I have peace like a river, peace like a river, I have peace like a river in my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I have love like an ocean, love like an ocean, I have love like an ocean in my soul; I have love like an ocean, love like an ocean, I have love like an ocean in my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I have joy like a fountain, joy like a fountain, I have joy like a fountain in my soul; I have joy like a fountain, joy like a fountain, I have joy like a fountain in my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee, God of glory, Lord of love; Hearts unfold like flowers before Thee, Opening to the sun above. Melt the clouds of sin and sadness, Drive the dark of doubt away; Giver of immortal gladness, Fill us with the light of day!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: All Thy works with joy surround Thee, Earth and heaven reflect Thy rays, Stars and angels sing around Thee, Centre of unbroken praise; Field and forest, vale and mountain, Flowery meadow, flashing sea, Singing bird and flowing fountain Call us to rejoice in Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Thou art giving and forgiving, Ever blessing, ever blessed, Wellspring of the joy of living, Ocean-depth of happy rest! Thou our Father, Christ our Brother- All who live in love are Thine: Teach us how to love each other, Lift us to the joy divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Mortals, join the happy chorus Which the morning stars began; Father love is reigning o'er us, Brother love binds man to man; Ever singing, march we onward, Victors in the midst of strife, Joyful music leads us sunward In the triumph song of life.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba yah! Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba yah! Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba yah! O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Someone's laughing, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's laughing, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's laughing, Lord, kumba yah! O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Someone's crying, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's crying, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's crying, Lord, kumba yah! O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Someone's praying, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's praying, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's praying, Lord, kumba yah! O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Someone's singing, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's singing, Lord, kumba yah! Someone's singing, Lord, kumba yah! O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba yah! Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba yah! Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba yah! O Lord, kumba yah!

title: I'M FEASTING AT HIS BANQUETING TABLE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I'm feasting at His banqueting table, His banner over me is love! I'm feasting at His banqueting table, His banner over me is love! I'm feasting at His banqueting table, His banner over me is love! His banner over me is love! I am my Beloved's and He is mine, His banner over me is love!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I am my Beloved's and He is mine, His banner over me is love! I am my Beloved's and He is mine, His banner over me is love! His banner over me is love! He is the Vine, and we're the branches, His banner over me is love! He is the Vine, and we're the branches, His banner over me is love!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: He is the Vine, and we're the branches, His banner over me is love! His banner over me is love!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: There is only one way to peace: Through the power of the cross; There is only one way to peace: Through the power of the cross; There is only one way to peace: Through the power of the cross. His banner over me is love!

title: O SPIRIT OF THE LIVING GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: O Spirit of the living God, Thou light and fire divine, Descend upon Thy church once more, and make it truly Thine. Fill it with love and joy and power, with righteousness and peace; Till Christ shall dwell in human hearts, and sin and sorrow cease.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Blow, Wind of God! With wisdom blow until our minds are free From mists of errors, clouds of doubt, which blind our eyes to Thee. Burn, winged fire! Inspire our lips with flaming love and zeal, To preach to all Thy great good news, God's glorious common weal.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Teach us to utter living words of truth which all may hear, The language all may understand when love speaks loud and clear; Till every age and race and clime shall blend their creeds in one, And earth shall form one family by whom Thy will is done.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: So shall we know the power of Christ who came this world to save; So shall we rise with Him to life which soars beyond the grave; And earth shall win true holiness, which makes Thy children whole; Still, perfected by Thee, we reach creation's glorious goal!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I stand amazed in the presence Of Jesus the Nazarene, And wonder how He could love me, A sinner, condemned, unclean.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: How marvellous, how wonderful, And my song shall ever be: How marvellous, how wonderful Is my Saviour's love for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: For me it was in the garden He prayed, "Not my will but Thine." He had no tears for His own griefs, But sweat of blood supplied for mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: In pity, angels beheld Him, And came from the world of light, To comfort Him in the sorrowsHe bore for my soul that night.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: He took my sins and my sorrows, He made them His very own; He bore the burden to Calv'ry, And suffered and died alone.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: When with the ransomed in glory, His face I at last shall see, 'Twillbe my joy through the ages To sing of His love for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: We praise Thee, O God For the Son of Thy Love, For Jesus who died and He's now gone above.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Hallelujah, Thine the glory Hallelujah, Amen, Hallelujah, Thine the glory Revive us again.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: We praise Thee O God For the Spirit of light, Who has shown us our Saviour and scattered all night.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: All glory and praise To the Lamb that was slain, Who has borne all our sin and has cleansed every stain.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Revive us again Fill each heart with Thy love, May each soul be rekindled with fire from above.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: We praise Thee, O God For the Son of Thy love For Jesus who died and He's now gone above.

title: MY SONG SHALL BE OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: My song shall be of Jesus, His mercy crowns my days; He fills my cup with blessings And tunes my heart to praise; My song shall be of Jesus, The precious Lamb of God, Who gave Himself my ransom And bought me with His blood.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: My song shall be of Jesus, When sitting at His feet, I call to mind His goodness And know my joy's complete; My song shall be of Jesus, Whatever ills befall; I'll sing the grace that saves me, And triumphs over all.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: My song shall be of Jesus, While pressing on my way To where my home shines glorious In pure and perfect day. And when my soul shall enter The many mansions fair, A song of praise to Jesus I'll sing forever there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I'd rather have Jesus than silver or gold, I'd rather be His than have riches untold; I'd rather have Jesus than houses or lands, I'd rather be led by His nail-pierced hand.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Than to be a king of a vast domain, Or be held in sin's dread sway; I'd rather have Jesus than anything This world affords today.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I'd rather have Jesus than men's applause, I'd rather be faithful to His dear cause; I'd rather have Jesus than world-wide fame, I'd rather be true to His holy name.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: He's fairer than lilies of rarest bloom, He's sweeter than honey from out the comb; He's all that my hungering spirit needs, I'd rather have Jesus and let Him lead.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Watchman, blow the gospel trumpet, Every soul a warning give; Whosoever hears the message May repent, and turn and live.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Blow the trumpet trusty watchman, Blow it loud o'er land and sea; God commissions, sound the message! Every captive may be free.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Sound it loud o'er every hilltop, Gloomy shade and sunny plain; Ocean depths repeat the message, Full salvation's glad chorus.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Sound it in the hedge and highway, Earth's dark spot where exiles roam; Let it tell all things are ready, Father waits to welcome home.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Sound it for the heavy-laden, Weary, longing to be free; Sound the Saviour's invitation, Sweetly saying, "Come to me."

title: HOW SWEET THE NAME OF JESUS SOUNDS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds, In a believer's ear! It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds, And drives away his fear.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: It makes the wounded spirit whole, And calms the troubled breast; 'Tis manna to the hungry soul, And to the weary, rest.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Dear name, the Rock on which I stand, My shield and hiding place, My never-failing treasure, filled With boundless stores of grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Jesus, my Shepherd, Saviour, Friend, My Prophet, Priest and King! My Lord, my Life, my Way, my End! Accept the praise I bring.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Weak is the effort of my heart, And cold my warmest thoughts; But when I see Thee as Thou hath, I'll praise Thee as I ought.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: I would Thy boundless love proclaim With every fleeting breath; So shall the music of Thy name Refresh my soul in death .

title: TELL ME THE STORY OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Tell me the story of Jesus: Write on my heart every word, Tell me the story most precious, Sweetest that ever was heard; Tell how the angels, in chorus, Sang as they welcomed His birth: "Glory to God in the highest, Peace and good tidings to earth!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Tell me the story of Jesus: Write on my heart every word, Tell me the story most precious, Sweetest that ever was heard.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Fasting alone in the dessert, Tell of the days that He passed; How for our sins He was tempted, Yet was triumphant at last; Tell of the years of His labour, Tell of the sorrows He bore; He was despised and afflicted, Homeless, rejected, and poor.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Tell of the cross where they nailed Him, Writhing in anguish and pain; Tell of the grave where they laid Him, Tell how He liveth again; Love in that story so tender, Clearer than ever I see; Stay, let me weep while you whisper, "Love paid the ransom for me."

title: AWAKE, MY SOUL, STRETCH EVERY NERVE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Awake, my soul, stretch every nerve, And press with vigour on; A heavenly race demands thy zeal, And an immortal crown, And an immortal crown.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: 'Tis God's animating voice That calls thee from on high; 'Tis He whose hand presents the prize To thine aspiring eye, To thine aspiring eye.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: A cloud of witnesses around Hold thee in full survey; Forget the steps already trod, And onward urge thy way, And onward urge thy way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Blest Saviour, introduced by Thee, Our race have we begun; And, crowned with victory, at Thy feet We'll lay our trophies down, We'll lay our trophies down.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: Then wake, my soul, stretch every nerve, And press with vigour on, A heavenly race demands thy zeal, And an immortal crown, And an immortal crown.

title: BE THOU MY VISION, O LORD OF MY HEART

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Be Thou my vision, O Lord of my heart; Naught be all else to me Save that Thou art, Thou my best Thought, by day or by night, Waking or sleeping, Thy presence my light.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Be Thou my wisdom, Be Thou my true Word; I ever with Thee, Thou with me, Lord; Thou my great Father, I Thy true son; Thou in me dwelling, and I with Thee one.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Be Thou my battle-shield, Sword for the fight; Be Thou my dignity, Thou my delight; Thou my soul's shelter, Thou my high tower: Raise Thou me heavenward, O power of my power.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Riches I heed not, Nor man's empty praise, Thou mine inheritance, Now and always: Thou and Thou only, first in my heart, High King of Heaven, my Treasure Thou art.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: High King of Heaven, When victory is won, May I reach Heaven's joys, O bright heaven's Sun! Heart of my own heart, whatever befall, Still be my vision, O Ruler of all.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Zion's King shall reign victorious, All the earth shall own His sway; He will make His kingdom glorious, He will reign through endless day.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Mighty King, Thine arm revealing, Now Thy glorious cause maintain, Bring the nations help and healing, Make them subject to Thy reign.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Nations now from God estranged Then shall see a glorious Light, Night to day shall then be changed, Heaven shall triumph in the sight.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Then shall Israel, long dispersed, Mourning, seek the Lord their God; "Look on Him whom once they pierced," Own and kiss the chastening rod.

title: THERE IS NO NAME SO SWEET

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: There is no name so sweet, Like Jesus' name, The Son of God, Who died on the cross.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: There is no name I know, Like Jesus' name, The Son of God, Who died on the cross.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: There is no name I love, Like Jesus' name, The Son of God, Who died on the cross.

title: A SHELTER IN THE TIME OF STORM

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: The Lord's our Rock in Him we hide, A shelter in the time of storm; Secure whatever may betide, A Shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Mighty Rock in a weary land, Cooling Shade on the burning sand, Faithful Guide for the pilgrim band, A Shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: A shade by day, defence by night, A Shelter in the time of storm; No fears alarm, no foes affright, A Shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: The raging floods may round us beat, A Shelter in the time of storm; We find in God a safe retreat, A shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: O Rock divine, O Refuge dear, A Shelter in the time of storm; Be Thou our Helper, ever near, A Shelter in the time of storm.

title: DEEPER, DEEPER IN THE LOVE OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Deeper, deeper in the love of Jesus, Daily let me go; Higher, higher in the school of wisdom, More of grace to know.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: O deeper yet I pray, And higher everyday And wiser, blessed Lord, In Thy precious, holy word.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Deeper, deeper! Blessed Holy Spirit, Take me deeper still, Till my life is wholly lost in Jesus And His perfect will.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Deeper, deeper! Though it costs hard trials, Deeper let me go! Rooted in the holy love of Jesus, Let me fruitful grow.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Deeper, higher everyday in Jesus Till all conflict past, Finds me conqueror, and in His own image Perfected at last.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: O, my comrades! See the signal Waving in the sky; Reinforcements now appearing, Victory is nigh. C HORUS "Hold the fort, for I am coming", Jesus signals still; Wave the answer back to Heaven, "By Thy grace, we will."

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: See the mighty host advancing, Satan leading on: Mighty men around us falling, Courage almost gone!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: See the glorious banner waving! Hear the trumpet blow! In our Leader's name we'll triumph Over every foe!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Fierce and long the battle rages, But our help is near: Onward comes our great Commander, Cheer, my comrades, cheer!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Listen to the Master's pleadings, There's urgent work for all, Heed the Spirit's interceding, Give this answer to the call:

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I am ready for service for Thee, dear Lord, Here am I, send me, I am willing to be what You'd have me be, I will go to where You want me to go. I am ready for service for Thee, dear Lord, Here am I, send me, Though the pathway seems dark For Thee I'll do or die, I am ready for service, Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: There's a voice to you now calling, Will you heed earnest word On the ear it's gently calling Give this answer to your Lord:

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Many souls in sins are dying, Haste to help them while you may, For the time is swiftly flying, Will you now to Jesus say:

title: LET THE LORD HAVE HIS WAY LET THE LORD HAVE HIS WAY IN YOUR HEART EVERYDAY! THERE'S NO REST, THERE'S NO PEACE, UNTIL THE LORD HAVE HIS WAY. PLACE YOUR LIFE IN HIS HANDS, REST SECURE IN HIS PLAN; LET THE LORD, LET THE LORD HAVE HIS WAY.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Whisper a prayer in the morning, Whisper a prayer at noon, Whisper a prayer in the evening, To keep your heart in tune.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: God answers prayer in the morning, God answers prayer at noon, God answers prayer in the evening, So keep your heart in tune.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Jesus may come in the morning, Jesus may come at noon, Jesus may come in the evening, So keep your heart in tune.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: 408 'TIS NOT AN EASY ROAD

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content: 'Tis not an easy road We are travelling to Heaven For many are the thorns on the way; 'Tis not an easy road But the Saviour is with us His presence gives us joy everyday.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: No, no! 'Tis not an easy road, No, no! 'Tis not an easy road; But Jesus walks beside me And brightens the journey And lightens the heavy load.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content: 'Tis not an easy road, There are trials and troubles And many are the dangers we meet; But Jesus guards and keeps so that nothing can harm us And smoothens rough paths for our feet.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content: Though I am often footsore and weary from travel, Though I am often bowed down with care; A better day is coming, when home in the glory We'll rest in perfect peace over there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: 'Tis not an easy road We are travelling to Heaven For many are the thorns on the way; 'Tis not an easy road But the Saviour is with us His presence gives us joy everyday.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: No, no! 'Tis not an easy road, No, no! 'Tis not an easy road; But Jesus walks beside me And brightens the journey And lightens the heavy load.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: 'Tis not an easy road, There are trials and troubles And many are the dangers we meet; But Jesus guards and keeps so that nothing can harm us And smoothens rough paths for our feet.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Though I am often footsore and weary from travel, Though I am often bowed down with care; A better day is coming, when home in the glory We'll rest in perfect peace over there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Once I was bound by sin's galling fetters, Chained like a slave, I struggled in vain; But I received a glorious freedom, When Jesus broke my fetters in twain.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Glorious freedom, wonderful freedom, No more in chains of sin I repine! Jesus the glorious Emancipator! Now and forever He shall be mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Freedom from all the carnal affections, Freedom from envy, hatred and strife; Freedom from vain and worldly ambitions, Freedom from all that saddened my life.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Freedom from pride and all sinful follies, Freedom from love and glitter of gold; Freedom from evil, temper, and anger, Glorious freedom, rapture untold!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: Freedom from fear with all of its torments, Freedom from care with all of its pain; Freedom in Christ, my blessed Redeemer, He who has rent my fetters in twain.

title: NOBODY BUT YOU, LORD NOBODY BUT YOU, LORD, NOBODY BUT YOU CAN KEEP ME HAPPY, CAN KEEP ME TRUE; ALL THROUGH LIFE'S JOURNEY YOU'LL CARRY ME THROUGH, NOBODY BUT YOU, LORD, NOBODY BUT YOU.
I SHALL BE NO STRANGER THERE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: When the pearly gates are opened To a sinner saved by grace, When thro' everlasting mercy, I behold my Saviour's face, When I enter in the mansions Of the city bright and fair, I shall have a royal welcome, For I'll be no stranger there.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I shall be no stranger there; Jesus will my place prepare; He will meet me, He will greet me; I shall be no stranger there.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Thro' time's ever changing seasons, I am pressing t'ward the goal; 'Tis my heart's sweet native country, 'Tis the homeland of my soul; Many loved ones, clothed with beauty, In those wondrous glories share; When I rise, redeemed, forgiven, I shall be no stranger there.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: There my dear Redeemer liveth, Blessed Lamb upon the throne; By the crimson marks upon them, He will surely claim His own. So, whenever sad or lonely, Look beyond the earthly care; Weary child of God, remember, You will no stranger there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I was sinking deep in darkness, I was drifting far from the shore And I felt, down in my heart, that the Lord loved me no more I was like a little beast upon the raging seas When God, rich in mercy, made a way for me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Mercy re-wrote my life, God's mercy re- wrote my life I should have fallen, and my soul cast down But God's mercy re-wrote my life.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I was blue and I was lonely, my heart was sinking deep Satan, he told me that no one really cared I was like a broken vessel, as broken as one could be When God, rich in mercy, made a way for me.

title: THINGS ARE DIFFERENT NOW THINGS ARE DIFFERENT NOW, SOMETHING HAPPENED TO ME WHEN I GAVE MY HEART TO JESUS; THINGS ARE DIFFERENT NOW, I WAS CHANGED IT MUST BE WHEN I GAVE MY HEART TO HIM; THINGS I LOVED BEFORE HAVE PASSED AWAY, THINGS I LOVE FAR MORE HAVE COME TO STAY; THINGS ARE DIFFERENT NOW, SOMETHING HAPPENED THAT DAY WHEN I GAVE MY HEART TO HIM.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Give me your hand let's agree together, That all our enemies crumble at our feet; For whatever we bind on earth shall be bound in Heaven At the name of Jesus Satan has to flee.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: We've got the power in the name of Jesus We've got the power, in the name of the Lord; Though Satan rages, we shall not be defeated, We've got the power, in the name of the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: For many years now Satan tried to stop us, But the bride of Jesus is still alive, Like a mighty army she keeps moving onward Winning every battle, for the Lord's on her side.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Lead us, Heavenly Father, lead us O'er the world's tempestuous sea; Guide us, guard us, keep us, feed us, For we have no help but Thee; Yet possessing every blessing, If our God our Father be.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Saviour breathe forgiveness o'er us, All our weakness Thou dost know; Thou didst tread the earth before us, Thou didst feel its keenest woe; Lone and dreary, faint and weary, Through the desert Thou didst go.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Spirit of our God descending, Fill our hearts with heavenly joy; Love with every feeling blending, Pleasures that can never cloy: Thus provided, pardoned, guided, Nothing can our peace destroy.

title: HE TOOK MY PLACE, AND DIED FOR ME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: A trembling soul, I sought the Lord, My sin confessed, my guilt deplored; How soft and sweet His word to me: "I took thy place and died for thee."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: No other hope, no other plea: He took my place and died for me. O precious Lamb of Calvary! He took my place and died for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Here rests my heart; assurance sweet: His blessed work He will complete, Since in His love so great and free He took my place and died for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: When sorrow veils the smiling day, When evil foes beset my way, Abundant grace in Him I see; He took my place and died for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: No room for doubt, no room for fears, When to my view the cross appears; My joyful song shall ever be: "He took my place and died for me."

title: I WOULD HAVE THE SAVIOUR WITH ME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I would have the Saviour with me, For I dare not walk alone; I would feel His presence near me, And His arm around me thrown.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Then my soul... shall fear no ill,... While He leads...me where He will,... I will go... without a murmur, And His footsteps follow still.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: I would have the Saviour with me, For my faith, at best, is weak; He can whisper words of comfort That no other voice can speak.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: I would have the Saviour with me In the onward march of life, Through the tempest and the sunshine, Through the battle and the strife.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content: I would have the Saviour with me, That His eye the way may guide, Till I reach the vale of Jordan, Till I cross the rolling tide.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: I'm in the way, the bright and shining way; I'm in the gloryland way, Telling the world that Jesus saves today... Yes, I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: I'm in the gloryland way, I'm in the gloryland way; Heaven's beautiful and the way's equally beautiful, I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: List'n to the call, the gospel call today, Get in the gloryland way; Wanderers,come home, O hasten to obey, For, I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: Onward I go rejoicing in His love, I'm in the gloryland way. Soon I shall see Him in the home above O, I'm in the gloryland way.

title: AT A TIME LIKE THIS AT A TIME LIKE THIS WHEN WE GATHER TOGETHER FROM THE EAST TO THE WEST, FROM NORTH AND SOUTH; WHEN WE GATHER TOGETHER IN THE NAME OF JESUS CHRIST, O LORD, ARISE AND SHINE.... O LORD, ARISE AND SHINE.
JESUS CHRIST IS THE SON OF GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content: Jesus Christ is the Son of God, O yes, O yes! Hallelujah He arose, O yes, O yes! Hallelujah He arose, the Son of God arose; Hallelujah He arose! O yes, O yes! Jesus Christ is the Prince of Peace O yes, O yes! Hallelujah He arose, O yes, O yes! Hallelujah He arose, the Prince of Peace arose; Hallelujah He arose! O yes, O yes!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content: Jesus Christ is the King of kings O yes, O yes! Hallelujah He arose,

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content: O yes, O yes! Hallelujah He arose, the King of kings arose; Hallelujah He arose! O yes, O yes!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content: Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails, Heaven and earth will pass away, But Jesus never fails. Your father may let you down Your brother may let you down The men of this world may let you down, But Jesus never fails.

title: O, WHAT PRECIOUS LOVE O WHAT PRECIOUS LOVE THE FATHER HATH FOR ADAM'S FALLEN RACE; GAVE HIS ONLY SON TO SUFFER, AND REDEEM US BY HIS GRACE.
I HAVE THE LIFE OF GOD IN ME I HAVE THE LIFE OF GOD IN ME I HAVE THE LIFE OF GOD IN ME I HAVE THE SPIRIT OF THE SON OF GOD I HAVE THE LIFE OF GOD IN ME.
I AM A BLESSED CHILD I AM A BLESSED CHILD I AM A BLESSED CHILD JESUS MAKES ME A BLESSED CHILD I AM A BLESSED CHILD.

POWER IN THE SPOKEN WORD THERE IS POWER IN THE SPOKEN WORD AS THE LORD TOLD THE PROPHET THERE IS POWER IN THE SPOKEN WORD BY THE SPOKEN WORD, THE SQUIRRELS WERE CREATED BY THE SPOKEN WORD, THE STORMS ROLLED AWAY.
